publicDescPublic: Access runs through the Editors / Viewers lists below. Any share code on this {{kind}} was revoked when it went public.
publicDescPrivate: Only you (and people invited via share code) can see this {{kind}}. Turning on Public revokes the share code — the two paths are mutually exclusive.
everyoneHint: Adding Everyone clears the rest of that list. You cannot mix Everyone with specific teams / users — the BE will block it.
makePrivateBody: All Editors and Viewers entries will be cleared. Individual share-link collaborators are not affected.
